prompt:
Fix snippets/loyalty-tier-2.liquid, which renders a customer's loyalty status card. Input: one top-level variable customer, which is always an object (never null) and always has these three keys, though each value can be null: - customer.first_name (string or null; may be empty, whitespace-only, padded with spaces, or contain <, >, &, " characters) - customer.tier (string or null; may be empty, whitespace-only, padded, or in any letter case) - customer.points (integer >= 0, or null) Output, with no whitespace or newlines between or around elements:
GREETING BADGE POINTS
(written here with spaces only for readability; the real output has none) GREETING: let NAME be first_name with leading and trailing whitespace removed (null counts as empty). If NAME is empty, output

Hi there

. Otherwise output

Hi NAME

with NAME HTML-escaped using the escape filter. BADGE: let T be tier stripped of surrounding whitespace and lowercased (null counts as empty). If T is gold, silver or bronze, output

LABEL member

where LABEL is Gold, Silver or Bronze respectively. For any other value, including null, empty and whitespace-only, output

Not a member yet

. POINTS: if points is null, output nothing for this part. If points is 0, output

No points yet

. If 1, output

1 point

. Otherwise output

N points

with N the integer. Note that 0 and null are different. Only core Liquid filters are available. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/loyalty-tier-2.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
